calendarYearHint: Set a Gregorian year as BC or AD. Each turn advances ten years. Simulation stops at AD 2500.
populationHint: Initial actors (1000–10000). Births happen per subregion, up to 10000 per column.
seedHint: RNG seed. Same value reproduces terrain, positions, traits, and ties.
taxRateHint: Higher burden favors obedience costs and resistance (0–1).
educationHint: Higher cooperation success and resource growth (0–1).
resourcePoolHint: Slack in hunting, gathering, and farming. Scarcity favors grabbing; plenty favors sharing.
theaterHint: The continental theater. Groups are snapped onto land.
geographyHint: The continental theater. Groups are snapped onto land.

conditionGroups.natureLead: Together with climate, this sets how much food and shared resource slack there is.
conditionGroups.disasterLead: How often typhoons, quakes, floods, heat waves, or cold snaps hit. The mix follows landform and climate.
conditionGroups.societyLead: Population, institutions, tax, education, and how readily people obey.
conditionGroups.religionLead: Shapes deference to authority and how often resistance appears.

religionHint: Polytheism leans loosely obedient; monotheism favors authority; secular outlooks make resistance easier.
ambitionHint: Higher leadership contests and political rivalry (0–1).
inequalityHint: Higher spread of wealth at t=0 (0–1).
landformHint: Continents have more interior; island chains favor coasts and fragmentation. This shapes the sim grid.
climateHint: Tints the theater and changes movement cost and resource growth. Not a full weather model.
institutionHint: Starting regime. Authority, resistance, and inequality can shift it later; no regime stays frozen.

wizard.lead1: Geography, nature, food, and sanitation are preset per chosen subregion. Read inland, coast, and islands in the table.
wizard.lead2: Set the start year and, per column, social rules and human disposition—the same land can still fork.
wizard.lead3: Per continent column: how unusual people appear, how wealth is shared, and how many people start there.
wizard.notableHint: How easily charisma or genius appears. Higher values bias the run toward outliers.
wizard.columnPopHint: How many people this continent column starts with (1000–10000). That is the group's starting size on the map.
wizard.welfareHint: How strongly this column shares wealth when it is uneven. Closer to none, inequality stays.

blurbs.northern_africa: Mediterranean to Sahara edge. Coast trade next to inland drought.
blurbs.eastern_africa: Rift to Indian Ocean. Highlands and savanna.
blurbs.middle_africa: Congo basin. Forest and rivers constrain travel.
blurbs.western_africa: Guinea coast and Sahel. Sharp coast–inland contrast.
blurbs.southern_africa: Plateau toward the Cape. Temperate mixed with arid.
blurbs.eastern_asia: East Asian temperate–monsoon belt. Plains and archipelagos.
blurbs.south_eastern_asia: Peninsula and islands. Seas and wet seasons steer people.
blurbs.southern_asia: Indian subcontinent. Monsoon and great rivers.
blurbs.central_asia: Steppe interior. Drought and distance dominate.
blurbs.western_asia: Western Asia. Arid lands meet trade routes.
blurbs.western_europe: Atlantic temperate west. Ports sit near plains.
blurbs.eastern_europe: Wide plains. Inland distances are long.
blurbs.northern_europe: Northern seas and cold. Fishing, short growing seasons.
blurbs.southern_europe: Mediterranean. Peninsulas and islands split easily.
blurbs.northern_america: North American temperate belt. Plains and two oceans.
blurbs.central_america: Isthmus. Short distances, seas on both sides.
blurbs.caribbean: Island chain. Storms and sea lanes dominate.
blurbs.south_america: Andes, Amazon, then temperate south. Long north–south span.
blurbs.australasia: Australia and New Zealand. Island-continent plus temperate isles.
blurbs.melanesia: Island arc around New Guinea. Mountains meet sea.
blurbs.micronesia: Tiny North Pacific islands. Land is dots.
blurbs.polynesia: Islands scattered over a huge ocean. Distance is the constraint.

northern_africa.inland: Sahara and oasis points. Travel is long; farms are dots.
northern_africa.coast: Mediterranean shore. Ports and irrigation gather people.
northern_africa.island: Few islands. Outposts like the Canaries sit off-stage.
northern_africa.climate: Mostly arid. Only the coast gets winter rain.
northern_africa.food: Scarce, clustered on the Nile and the coast.
northern_africa.disaster: Heat and dust. Quakes more often on the shore.
northern_africa.sanitation: Oases and towns lean on wells. Cleanliness varies sharply by place.

eastern_africa.inland: Highlands and the Rift. Livable inland, but valleys split groups.
eastern_africa.coast: Indian Ocean. Monsoon sea lanes are the doorway.
eastern_africa.island: Madagascar and large isles. Easy to diverge from the mainland.
eastern_africa.climate: Highlands cool; lowlands hot and dry.
eastern_africa.food: River valleys and highland herds, plus coastal fish.
eastern_africa.sanitation: Water quality splits highland vs valley. Outbreaks favor the lowlands.

middle_africa.inland: Congo forest. Few roads; the interior closes in.
middle_africa.coast: Gulf of Guinea. River-mouth ports are the thick exit.
middle_africa.island: Mainland-centered. Islands are not the main split.
middle_africa.food: Forest and river yield. Clearing land is heavy.
middle_africa.disaster: Floods and disease cut food slack.
middle_africa.sanitation: Forest rivers. Drainage is weak; disease lingers.

western_africa.inland: Sahel. Rain is unreliable; herding stays mobile.
western_africa.coast: Guinea coast. Wet ports and thick trade.
western_africa.island: Small coastal isles. Extensions of the mainland.
western_africa.climate: Wet season on the coast; long dry inland.
western_africa.food: Clustered on the coast and the Niger.
western_africa.disaster: Drought and heat. Storms also hit the coast.
western_africa.sanitation: Coast and interior differ. Rainy seasons foul the water.

southern_africa.inland: Plateau and Kalahari. Room to spread, but water is thin.
southern_africa.coast: Atlantic and Indian oceans. Fishing and ports.
southern_africa.island: The mainland dominates. Isles are outposts.
southern_africa.climate: More temperate. Winter rain in the southwest; dry inland.
southern_africa.food: Highland grain and herds, plus coastal fish.
southern_africa.sanitation: Plateau water is steadier. Dense spots still see outbreaks.

eastern_asia.inland: Loess and interior plateau. Cold and dry inland.
eastern_asia.coast: East China Sea side. Plains and ports hold people.
eastern_asia.island: Japan and others. Crossing is possible; institutions split.
eastern_asia.climate: Temperate monsoon. Summer rain; cold inland winters.
eastern_asia.food: Thick grain on river plains. Islands add fishing.
eastern_asia.disaster: Floods and quakes. Typhoons on the coast.
eastern_asia.sanitation: Rivers and cities can keep cleaner. Density also speeds contagion.

south_eastern_asia.inland: Peninsula mountains. Valleys cut settlements apart.
south_eastern_asia.coast: Monsoon coasts. Ports and deltas are the core.
south_eastern_asia.island: Archipelago is nearly the body. Neighbors sit across water.
south_eastern_asia.climate: Tropical wetland. Long rains, high heat.
south_eastern_asia.food: Rice and fish. Rich, but water can fail them.
south_eastern_asia.sanitation: Heat and wet spoil water. Ports and deltas carry infection.

southern_asia.inland: Deccan and dry interior. Monsoon reach splits.
southern_asia.coast: Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal. Ports and fishing.
southern_asia.island: Sri Lanka and others. Cut off by sea.
southern_asia.climate: Monsoon. Dry spells alternate with downpours.
southern_asia.food: Great rivers and deltas. Interior has lean years.
southern_asia.disaster: Floods and cyclones, then drought in turn.
southern_asia.sanitation: Monsoon and great rivers. Epidemics follow floods.

central_asia.inland: Steppe and basins. Long distances; oases are points.
central_asia.coast: Almost no sea. Closed interior is the given.
central_asia.island: No real islands. Lakes are the edges.
central_asia.climate: Arid with hard winters and swings.
central_asia.food: Herding first. Irrigated oases are narrow.
central_asia.disaster: Drought and cold snaps. Quakes in the mountains.
central_asia.sanitation: Water is scarce. A fouled oasis is fatal.

western_asia.inland: Plateau and desert. Caravan routes are the inland axis.
western_asia.coast: Mediterranean, Red Sea, Gulf. Ports are the door.
western_asia.island: A few isles like Cyprus. Easy to sit outside mainland politics.
western_asia.climate: Arid. Winter-rain coasts next to interior desert.
western_asia.food: Clustered on irrigated valleys. Herds are wide but thin.
western_asia.sanitation: Irrigation and caravan wells. Contamination hits settlements.

western_europe.inland: Plains continue. People gather even inland.
western_europe.coast: Atlantic. Fishing and ports sit close.
western_europe.island: Britain and others. Sea crossings split institutions.
western_europe.climate: Temperate west-coast. Steady rain, fewer extremes.
western_europe.food: High slack. Grain and pasture mix well.
western_europe.disaster: Relatively mild. Atlantic storms on the west.
western_europe.sanitation: Sewers and hygiene come earlier. Outbreaks are easier to contain.

eastern_europe.inland: Great plains. Long distances; winters close the land.
eastern_europe.coast: Baltic and Black Sea. Ports sit at the edges.
eastern_europe.food: Thick on the black earth. Short seasons in the north.
eastern_europe.disaster: Cold snaps. Drought on the southern steppe.
eastern_europe.sanitation: Wells on the plain. Winter crowding keeps indoor infection.

northern_europe.inland: Forest and lakes. Inland farming is bound to a short summer.
northern_europe.coast: North Sea and Baltic. Fish and sea lanes are the core.
northern_europe.island: Many isles and fjords. Splits are normal.
northern_europe.food: Fish and herds. Little grain slack.
northern_europe.disaster: Winter storms and cold. Famine years happen.
northern_europe.sanitation: Cold slows rot. Famine years and crowding still bite.

southern_europe.coast: Mediterranean. Ports and fishing sit close.
southern_europe.island: Peninsulas and isles are the body. Crossing is daily.
southern_europe.climate: Dry summers, winter rain. Hot inland.
southern_europe.food: Olive, grain, fish. Water runs short in summer.
southern_europe.sanitation: Dense ports. Summer drought drops hygiene.

northern_america.inland: Great plains. Room to spread, but distances are long.
northern_america.coast: Two oceans. Ports and fisheries split east and west.
northern_america.climate: Mostly temperate. Cold north; drier interior.
northern_america.disaster: Storms and cold snaps. West-coast quakes mix in.
northern_america.sanitation: Water is plentiful. Urban crowding speeds outbreaks.

central_america.coast: Two oceans close by. Short runs to port.
central_america.island: A thin mainland. Offshore isles add splits.
central_america.food: Clustered in valleys and coasts. Medium slack.
central_america.sanitation: Rainy-season water fouls easily. The isthmus moves contagion.

caribbean.inland: Islands are small. Almost no interior.
caribbean.coast: Nearly all coastal. Sea lanes are the lifeline.
caribbean.island: The stage is the archipelago. Neighbors sit across water.
caribbean.food: Fish and thin farms. Uneven by island.
caribbean.disaster: Hurricanes hit hard and wipe food slack.
caribbean.sanitation: Fresh water is thin. Outbreaks race around an island.

south_america.inland: Amazon and highlands. Wide interior; slow to reach.
south_america.island: Mainland first. Offshore isles at the edge.
south_america.climate: Equatorial wetland to southern temperate. Long span.
south_america.food: Rich lowlands. Thin in highlands and dry belts.
south_america.disaster: Floods and quakes. Cold snaps in the south.
south_america.sanitation: Wet lowlands favor disease. Highlands stay drier.

australasia.inland: Australian interior is arid. People live in dots.
australasia.coast: Southeast and New Zealand. Ports and fishing hold people.
australasia.island: NZ is an island country. Australia is an island-continent.
australasia.food: Clustered on coasts and rivers. Thin inland herds.
australasia.disaster: Drought and wildfire. Quakes on the island side.
australasia.sanitation: Coastal towns can stay cleaner. Inland water is dots.

melanesia.inland: High-island mountains. Valleys close the interior.
melanesia.coast: Reefs and bays. Fish and canoe routes.
melanesia.island: The arc is the body. Crossing is required.
melanesia.climate: Wet tropics. Heavy rain and heat.
melanesia.food: Roots and fish. Slack is small per island.
melanesia.sanitation: Valley water splits by village; hygiene is uneven.

micronesia.inland: Land is dots. Interior is the lagoon, not a hinterland.
micronesia.coast: Almost all coastal. Fresh water is the limit.
micronesia.island: Tiny chained isles. Distance is the wall.
micronesia.food: Fishing first. Farmland is extremely thin.
micronesia.disaster: Typhoons and surge. A whole island can be hit.
micronesia.sanitation: Atoll freshwater is thin. Contamination spreads at once.

polynesia.coast: Lagoons and open ocean. Fishing is the center.
polynesia.island: Scattered over a huge sea. Voyaging is assumed.
polynesia.food: Fish and thin farms. Stores matter.
polynesia.disaster: Storms and tsunami. Isolation stretches the damage.
polynesia.sanitation: Islands isolate, but boats still carry pathogens.
